authority: UI_LAB_DESIGN_REFERENCE_ONLY — dev-only, production-disabled candidate presentation under src/app/dev/ui-lab/gate-c/. Not a production implementation, not an authorization, not a security proof.
note: Gate C W3 — C07 (Today, Assistant Coach contextual fallback, fixture-driven only — explicit authority override of Gate C W1's own earlier deferral, see SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md) and C08-A/B/C (Today-side same-day quick add — planning open, tentative availability, planning closed; fully prop-driven real TodaySurface fixtures). C08-D (guest) and C08-E (late arrival) have no fixture route here: the real AddPlayerDialog self-fetches its candidate lists via Server Actions and cannot be meaningfully fixture-mocked without either seeding a real match anyway or faking a result (forbidden by the brief). They are evidenced instead by real-DB integration tests (league-match-guest-actions.test.ts, new; match-helper-actions.test.ts, pre-existing) — see C08_OPERATIONAL_ACCEPTANCE.md. Two real findings while building against real production code: (1) guest-add actions had no cancelled-match guard, unlike the equivalent real-Player path — fixed in this branch (league-match-guest-actions.ts's requireMatchNotCancelled()). (2) Guests are entirely absent from the live-reporting pre-match package (getLiveMatchPreMatchPackageAction), so a guest cannot be selected for a live event — a real, disclosed capability gap, too large for this wave's scope, filed as https://github.com/lagebj/matchboard/issues/842, with a regression test documenting current behavior. ADR-0151's document status was corrected from 'Proposed' to 'Accepted' (decisions 1-3 were already fully shipped). Issues #827/#830 remain open, unrelated, untouched — this wave uses its own new, non-shared fixture directory (gate-c/w3-shared/) specifically to avoid re-triggering #827. REMEDIATION PASS (an independently-authored review against PR #843's then-current head found 6 real issues, all fixed or explicitly disclosed — see REVIEW_RECORD.md pass 3 for the full finding-by-finding record): (1) C07-ON's Promote/Dismiss previously called the real, session-requiring Server Actions against a synthetic fixture id that has no persisted record — fixed with an optional actions override on AssistantCoachHypothesisPanel (production unaffected; real actions still run when the override is omitted), with Vitest and Playwright coverage proving zero real network calls occur and the page explicitly discloses the simulated nature. (2) C08-A/C's quick-add/rejection were real-DB-tested but had no authenticated browser-level journey connecting the display fixture to the real mutation — investigated building new test-agent seed infrastructure and requesting the acceptance-label Test-slot provisioning, found the repo's own round-mutation.spec.ts precedent for this exact shape is itself test.skip()-disabled due to a documented Vercel-serverless timeout class, put the cost/risk tradeoff to the repository owner directly, and the owner chose to document the limitation rather than fund it — every C08 scenario's disposition is now explicitly PARTIAL (server-side evidence only), never PASS, for exactly this reason. (3) C08-B conflated tentative availability with the official register's 'after RSVP' state; the official requirement is now explicitly marked BLOCKED (Matchboard has no RSVP-deadline mechanism at all) across every doc, with the tentative-availability coverage relabelled as disclosed supplementary evidence only. (4) C08-D/E's evidence-tier distinction (real-DB vs browser-level) is now explicit in C08_OPERATIONAL_ACCEPTANCE.md rather than implied. (5) Two production-code comments referenced e2e spec files that were never created — corrected to point at the real evidence. (6) A further, genuinely separate review-agent pass over the final remediated diff is recorded in REVIEW_RECORD.md once complete. See CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT.md, DATA_TRUTH_AND_FIXTURES.md, BLOCKERS.md, SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md, VISUAL_VS_CURRENT.md, REVIEW_RECORD.md, C07_PRODUCTION_INTEGRATION_GAP.md, and C08_OPERATIONAL_ACCEPTANCE.md for full detail. Two further findings from the real CI runs during remediation, both fixed (see REVIEW_RECORD.md passes 5-7): a React Server Components serialization crash from a plain function value crossing the server/client boundary in the C07-ON fixture (moved the simulated-actions construction client-side, activated via a plain boolean prop), and two residual defects once the page could render (an overly-broad Playwright network assertion counting unrelated /api/csp-report POSTs, and a 6px horizontal overflow at 320px from a long unbroken file-path citation in the on-page disclosure text). capture-attestation.json is now committed, built from the first fully green run (ui-lab-review-45133382324-1, commit 20401088) with every hash independently re-verified via sha256sum against the real downloaded files. All candidates remain CANDIDATE pending owner review.
